problemFound: The canonical Danchi LOD generator creates LOD1-3 as renderer-subset proxies that initially share the LOD0 metric physical-UV mesh and material references, but existing LOD QA only checked renderer counts, transition thresholds and proxy-root ownership. A later mesh/material/property-block/transform drift could therefore leave LOD0 physical-UV QA green while a retained proxy changes texture phase, manufacture-grain scale, BRDF response, shadow/probe behavior or position during cross-fade. ReflectionProbe.RenderProbe can also render these proxies while bypassing MainCamera pre-cull.
implemented: Added Assets/QA/detail_lod_physical_uv_binding_contract.json with exact four-level/cross-fade/proxy-identity requirements, canonical 100 percent crops and exact critical-defect IDs visible_lod_pop plus severe_aliasing_or_shimmer.

Added QualityBlockDetailLodPhysicalUvBindingQA. It validates exact source-to-proxy shared mesh/material identity, no source/proxy MaterialPropertyBlock, world transform/layer/render-state identity, persisted physical-UV mesh location, complete UV0/tangents, proxy-root ownership, progressive LOD reduction and canonical transition heights.

Registered a formal-camera pre-cull guard for QA4K_ and QAPreparedTemporal_ native 3840x2160 targets so retained LOD proxy continuity is fail-closed before formal still or temporal evidence can render.

Upgraded reflection_detail_physical_uv_binding_contract.json to schema 1.1 and routed reflection fingerprint validation through the LOD continuity guard, which itself chains to the source physical-UV contract. The existing reflection fingerprint lifecycle therefore revalidates source plus retained proxies before RenderProbe request, on every observed Editor poll, at completion and immediately before still capture.

Confirmed the canonical Visual Fidelity gate uses visible_lod_pop and severe_aliasing_or_shimmer; the new contract validator also verifies those IDs exist in visual_fidelity_gate.json rather than accepting local aliases.

verification.notes: Reviewed the current LOD generator and confirmed retained proxies are authored by copying sharedMesh/sharedMaterials plus world transform and lighting/probe flags from LOD0. The new QA makes those assumptions executable and fail-closed. No Unity Runner, sealed render, workflow artifact or runtime evidence was available in this run, so cross-fade appearance remains unverified.

Critical defects: reduces source-side risk for visible_lod_pop and severe_aliasing_or_shimmer but clears neither defect without actual pixels.
